plan.title: Material PR to Reverse Auction PO

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Commit the supported 30-minute event schedule.
Invite two QA vendors so two distinct vendor bids can be submitted.
Publish the auction after the supported prerequisites are complete.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Submit the first vendor's portal bid at 100.
Verify the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Submit a different vendor's portal bid at 90.
Verify the second vendor's bid was accepted.
Wait for the bidding window to end before evaluating and awarding.
Open the buyer comparison grid after bidding has ended.
Assert that the lower bid ranks better and at least two vendors are ranked.
Allocate the complete award to the lowest-ranked vendor.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted proposal with the required remark.
Complete approval and create the purchase order.
Verify one PO contains exactly the awarded PR line.
Return to the events list to inspect the event's history placement.
Open the History tab after the event has ended and been awarded.
Verify this plan's event appears in event history.
